omissions: Selected violet/mauve, medium-radius, 100% configuration; not every Radix color, scale or variant.
No Radix runtime, keyboard implementation, icons, font binaries or local font-metric patches.
sRGB fallback shadows are mapped; display-P3 and color-mix enhancements are omitted.
No general motion scale or formal Radix principle catalog is invented; principles below condense published guidance.

Focus-ring styling remains component-specific. color.monet.accent-tint is Monet’s opaque violet-3 choice, not Radix --accent-surface / --violet-surface; no generic selected-surface contrast contract is claimed.
Only five components and two compositions are covered; consult upstream for all other decisions.

The opaque mauve-derived light background and surface differ from Radix’s documented white background/solid panel and translucent surface. Dark opaque gray-1/gray-2 choices do not implement translucent panels.

The included Card and Table evidence does not establish general avoidance lists. Those lists remain empty, producing two selected-component coverage warnings; the source-backed notes and usage remain available.

principles.title: Keep interaction accessible
principles.body:
Preserve semantic elements, accessible names, keyboard navigation and managed focus when implementing controls. Styling alone does not implement these behaviors. Test the resulting interface with its real content.

Monet adaptation: Radix. [source-012](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/primitives/docs/overview/accessibility.mdx)

principles.title: Compose from shared decisions
principles.body:
Use the same spacing, type and color vocabulary for custom controls and built-in-looking controls. Compose layouts from predictable blocks and shared scales instead of independently styling each screen.

Monet adaptation: Radix. [source-013](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/overview/styling.mdx) [source-014](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/overview/layout.mdx)

components.rationale: Action control with an explicit size and visual emphasis.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Radix: Default size 2 and solid variant. Documented alternatives include soft, outline, surface, classic and ghost. Loading disables the control while preserving its size. Keep focus-visible treatment and an accessible label.

components.rationale: Single-line input with consistent control styling.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Radix: Use size 2 by default. Surface, classic and soft styles are alternatives. Slot content can hold icons or actions; it does not replace an accessible label. Preserve disabled/read-only semantics in the implementation.

components.rationale: Semantic rows and columns for related values.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Radix: Use Table.ColumnHeaderCell and Table.RowHeaderCell for column and row headers. The Cell API uses justify to distribute horizontal space. The documented surface variant adds a backplate. This preset supplies no numeric-alignment recommendation or sorting, selection and pagination behavior.

[source-020](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/components/table.mdx)

components.rationale: Focused work presented above the current page.
components.notes:
Monet adaptation of Radix: Provide a title and description, a trigger, content and an explicit closing path. Preserve focus management and keyboard behavior from the underlying accessible-dialog contract. Use an alert dialog when confirmation of a consequential action is required.

patterns.title: Focused editing
patterns.summary: Compose a short edit task with an input, dialog and explicit actions.
patterns.body:
Monet adaptation of Radix guidance.

Provide the dialog title/description, labeled fields, save and close actions. Use the documented loading state during submission and preserve focus behavior. This is a Monet composition of the included component guidance, not a new upstream pattern.

patterns.title: Structured summary
patterns.summary: Use containers and tables for related information.
patterns.body:
Monet authored composition using Radix guidance.

Group related content in a Card and show rows and columns in a Table with the documented header cells. Compose the surrounding layout with shared spacing props. This combination is a Monet-authored example; it specifies neither numeric alignment nor a ghost-style preference.

Sources: [source-022](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/components/card.mdx) [source-020](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/components/table.mdx) [source-014](https://github.com/radix-ui/website/blob/bb424082fd33fadc244a6dd276d3ced55caa6234/data/themes/docs/overview/layout.mdx)
